bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.pivot_tran: Show the pivot editing row in XYZ transform editors (pose, etc.)
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.pose_keyfr: Show hierarchical collapse arrows on expanded pose bone tracks
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.snow_actio: Controls snow_actions start/end keyframes, looping, and overlay tracks. Enabled by default; reopen the film panel or reload the model after changing it.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.locked_lay: Disable edge dragging while layout is locked
When enabled, locked film layouts ignore edge dragging; off by default
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.chinese_ke: When enabled, track names in the keyframe editor are displayed in Chinese for easier identification.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.film_auto_: Auto switch to spectator in editor
Automatically switch to spectator mode when opening the film editor, and restore when closing.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.prevent_ne: When enabled, prevents dragging or adding keyframes before 0 seconds (negative time) in the keyframe editor.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.reverse_ti: When enabled, reverses the wheel-driven timeline direction in the film editor, including Ctrl+wheel playhead, Alt+wheel selected keyframes/clips, and Alt+wheel horizontal scrolling.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.direct_par: When enabled, Shift-clicking a model part in the replay editor directly selects its parent bone instead of showing the hierarchy menu.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.enable_iri: When enabled and Iris is installed, shows a shader control shortcut button on the right side of the film editor button bar.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.enable_ui_: When enabled and the keyframe editor layout is locked, the divider between track names and the curve graph is also hidden.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.world_film: Apply shader curves in world playback
When enabled, sun, weather, sky color, and Iris shader parameters in curve clips also apply when playing films in-world with Right Ctrl.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.allow_clip: Allow clip track expansion by dragging
When enabled, dragging a clip beyond the top of the timeline no longer limits track depth, allowing more tracks like vanilla BBS.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.private_bb: When enabled, BBS-specific copy data (replays, keyframes, forms, transforms) is kept inside BBS Cubed instead of the system clipboard. Normal text, colors, paths, and commands still use the system clipboard.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.auto_disab: When enabled, automatically generates config.json with culling=false for all models that don't have one. Existing config.json files are untouched.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.film_alt_w: Sets the behavior of Alt+mouse wheel when no keyframe is selected in the film editor keyframe view. Moving selected keyframes always works.
bbspp.config.item_spray.title: Item Spray
bbspp.config.item_spray.item_spray_frust: When enabled, item spray particles outside the player's view skip item rendering to reduce frame drops with many particles.
bbspp.config.item_spray.item_spray_max_r: Item spray particles beyond this distance skip rendering. Set to 0 to follow the client view distance automatically.
Limits how many item spray particles can be drawn per frame. Set to 0 for no limit.
bbspp.config.item_spray.item_spray_irlit: When IR Lights shadow casting is enabled, limits how many item spray particles can cast shadows. Set to 0 to disable item spray shadows.
bbspp.config.item_spray.tooltip: Item spray particle rendering and performance settings

bbspp.config.gizmo_modifications.gizmo_t: Only effective when Blockbench Flavor Gizmo is enabled. When on, T cycles: Translate -> Scale -> Rotate -> Combined -> ...
bbspp.config.gizmo_modifications.gizmo_k: Only effective when Blockbench Flavor Gizmo is enabled. When on, pressing G/S/R a second time runs the original BBS hotkey function instead of restoring the previous mode

bbspp.config.ui_enhancements.shader_curv: Use the new categorized shader curve picker when adding curves.

bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.pose_bone_: When enabled, pose editor bones are indented by the model hierarchy and connected with tree guides. Search results remain flat
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.first_pers: When enabled, restores vanilla walking view bobbing effect when playing a 'First Person Replay'. This effect is a simulated implementation rather than directly reusing the game's native mechanism. Enabling this option will override and disable the original BBS bobbing implementation.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.new_morphi: When enabled, the morphing panel will use the new dual-column layout. When disabled, it will use the vanilla vertical layout.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.new_film_l: When enabled, the film selection screen will use the new film library layout and interactions. When disabled, it will fully use the original film UI.
bbspp.config.bbs_enhancements.shader_cur: When enabled, adding shader curves in curve clips uses the new picker grouped by shader settings. When disabled, BBS uses the vanilla flat list.
